svg.title: Embeddings: a lookup, then position added on top
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Embeddings: a lookup, then position added on top” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn whiteboard in three bands: an embedding matrix of 128,256 rows by 4,096 columns with row 9,514 highlighted and an arrow taking it out as a single 4,096-wide vector strip labelled LOOKUP; four stacked token strips labelled with the tensor shape beside a crossed-out shuffled copy showing that a set has no order, with two fixes drawn side by side - adding a sinusoidal wave for absolute position and rotating the vector by m times theta for RoPE; and a bar chart of Llama-3-8B KV-cache size at 8k, 32k and 128k context reaching 1, 4 and 16 GiB against a red line marking the 7.9 GiB left on a 24 GB card.
svg.text: Embeddings: a lookup, then position added on top
draw it from memory, then compare
